public.prompt: Recover the masked affine operator f: GF(101)^100 -> GF(101)^100. You may intervene with the probe tool. Submit offset and sparse rows, where output[i] = (offset[i] + sum(term.coefficient * input[term.column] for term in rows[i])) modulo 101. Indices start at zero. Infer a map that works on new inputs, not just your observed examples. All coefficients and coordinates are canonical integers 0 through 100.

rows.description: Exactly 100 lists of {column: int, coefficient: int}. No duplicate columns within a row; omitted entries mean zero.

probe.description: Evaluate the operator on one intervention vector; no state is changed.

public.submission_rule: One final submission. Grades are evaluator-only; no retry after submission.
